para.verbatim:
embed:rst This class inherits from :cpp:class:`TexReplace` A :cpp:class:`TexReplace` that actually **edits** the texture it names, by building a real :cpp:class:`RemapTexEditResource` around a caller-supplied :cpp:class:`TexEditor` :raw-html:`
` :raw-html:`
` This exists for the same reason :cpp:class:`VGRemapBlendReplace` does, and the two are worth reading together. :cpp:class:`TexReplace` names things correctly but deliberately does not override :cpp:func:`BaseResEdit::buildResModel`, because the texture editor that does the work reaches it from `Python`_ -- so a fix driven from **plain C++** collects the textures, renames them, rewrites the registers that point at them, reports success, and writes no edited file at all. The failure is completely silent: the ``.ini`` file looks right and the texture it names is simply never created :raw-html:`
` :raw-html:`
` Use it through :cpp:class:`ResRegCollect`, exactly as the blend is: .. code-block:: cpp faceCollect_.srcRegs = {{faceGraph, "ps-t0"}}; faceCollect_.resEdits = {{"face", faceReplace_.get()}}; .. note:: The editor is held through a ``std::shared_ptr`` to its base and SHARED by every resource this builds, so a subclass's own :cpp:func:`BaseTexEditor::fix` -- a `Python`_ :class:`TexEditor`'s included -- is the one that runs. A copy of the base would drop it
